purpose: Collect one fixed development-only successor screen after measurement-complete v2 failed its exact useful-coverage gate. This screen may reject or motivate freezing a successor; it cannot establish confirmation, statistical significance, or replication.

paired_evidence_masks.operation: remove retained costmap cell payload while preserving declared metadata and hashes
remove delivered odometry samples while preserving the governed unmasked record

target_capabilities: bounded geometric restriction and route change without converting a retained grid into global physical no-path
persistent delivered-command versus measured-motion discrepancy with unresolved physical alternatives
successful measured-response recovery without asserting that recovery ordering proves causation
similar navigation symptoms separated by geometry versus execution measurements
irrelevant side clutter without a Nav2-consumption or obstacle-causation claim
qualification when decisive costmap or odometry evidence is masked
false-premise handling on a recorded successful outcome
complete communication of independently declared decisive measurements and limitations

run_contract.freshness_basis: The prior measurement-complete v2 screen consumed connected-detour 007-009 and nominal-clear-route 008-010. Earlier candidate screens consumed connected-detour 001-006 and nominal-clear-route 001-007. The selected connected-detour 010-012 and nominal-clear-route 011-012 configurations have no prior governed episode allocation.

method_screen_boundary.next_gate: After all five physical attempts and both masks are retained, independently compute and govern references, freeze exact P/R treatment artifacts and information-parity packets, and only then authorize one response per condition.
method_screen_boundary.baseline_R: A strong repository-aware, tool-enabled agent with the same robot-visible primitive evidence, embedded independent computations, exact relevant source/configuration, retrieval and deterministic calculation tools, and a comparable or stronger model/resource budget; it receives no P certificate, checked plan, verifier verdict, or P answer.
method_screen_boundary.candidate_P: Coverage-complete checked composition using the command-motion v2 adapter and geometric v4 adapter, deterministic composition and rendering, and zero model calls.
method_screen_boundary.judge: The exact qualified Luna v12 release in two fresh isolated passes, only after a separately hash-frozen annotation predeclaration and packet freeze.
method_screen_boundary.promotion_gate: P must show a recurring supported-diagnostic-success advantage over R across independent clusters and both mechanism families, no material-error or causal-overclaim excess, no useful-coverage degradation, correct masked/ambiguous/false-premise handling, and complete method/judge evidence parity. The exact gates may not be relaxed after responses. This development screen cannot establish statistical significance.

stopping: Attempt each fixed physical configuration exactly once in order and stop after five attempts. Retain every outcome and failed attempt. Do not add favorable layouts, replacements, retries, questions, generations, or judge passes after inspecting results.
